heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: two options are opposites; key likely one pole of the axis

heuristics.name: cluster-outlier
heuristics.description: three options near-synonyms; odd one out likely key

heuristics.name: pair-coherence
heuristics.description: two-blank pair whose halves fit a natural relation

heuristics.name: repeated-word
heuristics.description: first word repeated across pairs; picked coherent variant

notes: Options-only; no option could be ruled out with certainty without the sentence, so reject_certain is false throughout. Antonym-pair and cluster-outlier are weak structural priors, not semantic evidence.
